Game Overview

Idle Landmark Builder puts players into a idle experience centered on embark on a journey as a construction tycoon, building iconic landmarks from scratch. Manage workers, allocate resources, and tap to boost progress. Transform your construction site into a thriving empire and witness world-famous structures rise under your command. Can you master the art of landmark creation?
